content.short: Helixbox Bridge is a fully open-source and decentralized cross-chain asset bridge.
content.description: Helixbox Bridge builds on established messaging bridges that connect multiple chains, enabling cross-chain transfers that are secure, fast, and low-cost. By separating the underlying generic messaging layer from the asset-bridging process, it reduces risk and limits exposure to a single point of failure. Its trustless design strengthens security and resilience by avoiding centralized bottlenecks and distributing responsibilities, contributing to durable interoperability across the supported networks.
